cases.name: mixed_order_delegator_key_with_k_0_mod_8
cases.note: A' = A + (order-8 point); signature grinds k = 0 mod 8 so the COFACTORLESS equation holds. Only a verifier that rejects non-torsion-free keys (TS) rejects it.
cases.ts_reason: hop 1: bad signature (not signed by expected key)

cases.name: prime_order_key_with_torsion_R
cases.note: A is prime order; R = rB + (order-8 point). The cofactorless equation cannot hold, so the R torsion test is never the only reason.
cases.ts_reason: hop 1: bad signature (not signed by expected key)

cases.name: mixed_order_key_and_mixed_order_R_cofactorless_valid
cases.note: A' = A + T and R = rB + [3]T chosen so that [S]B = R + [k]A' holds cofactorlessly (k mod 8 = 5); both points are mixed-order.
cases.ts_reason: hop 1: bad signature (not signed by expected key)

cases.ts_reason: hop 1: bad signature (not signed by expected key)
